title: ChatAreaComposer: a11y fixes + send button + correctness
description: Fix 6 issues in ChatAreaComposer.tsx: (1) Replace aria-hidden with tabIndex=-1 on Trash2 (WCAG A11Y-001), (2) Add aria-live region for copy success (A11Y-002), (3) Diagnose and fix send button mouse click regression, (4) Add null guard on lastAssistantContent, (5) Add focus ring to Paperclip button, (6) Clean up setTimeout on unmount
action: Fix 6 distinct issues in ChatAreaComposer.tsx. A11Y: replace aria-hidden={input.length === 0 || undefined} with tabIndex={input.length === 0 ? -1 : undefined} on Trash2 button. A11Y: add {copied ? 'Copied!' : ''} after the copy button. Correctness: add if (!lastAssistantContent) return; at top of copyLastReply, remove ! assertion. Send button: inspect the button area for z-index/pointer-events/overflow issues that block mouse clicks. Paperclip: add focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 to Paperclip button className. setTimeout cleanup: store timer ID in useRef, clear in useEffect cleanup triggered by copied state.

criteria: src/components/ChatAreaComposer.tsx contains 'tabIndex={' at the Trash2 button location
convergence.verification: grep each criterion string above; run npm test
convergence.definition_of_done: All 6 issues fixed, tests pass, no TypeScript errors

files.change: Replace aria-hidden with tabIndex on Trash2; add sr-only live region for copy; add null guard; add Paperclip focus ring; add setTimeout cleanup via useEffect/ref

implementation: A11Y-001: At the Trash2 button (~line 115), replace aria-hidden={input.length === 0 || undefined} with tabIndex={input.length === 0 ? -1 : undefined}. Remove the aria-hidden attribute entirely.
A11Y-002: After the copy button closing tag, add: {copied ? 'Copied!' : ''}
CORR-001: In copyLastReply handler (~line 55-59), add 'if (!lastAssistantContent) return;' as first line. Change lastAssistantContent! to lastAssistantContent.

ISS-065: Inspect the send button area and surrounding container for: z-index conflicts, pointer-events:none from parent, overflow:hidden clipping, or overlapping elements. Check if the outer flex container or any sibling element intercepts clicks. Fix by adding position:relative z-10 to the send button or removing any blocking overlay.
BP-011: Add 'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50' to the Paperclip button className at ~line 95.

BP-008: Convert copied setTimeout to useEffect pattern: useEffect(() => { if (!copied) return; const id = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); return () => clearTimeout(id); }, [copied]). Remove the setTimeout from copyLastReply handler (keep setCopied(true) only).

reference.pattern: focus-visible ring pattern from other toolbar buttons
reference.examples: Existing focus-visible rings on BookmarkPlus, Trash2, Copy buttons
